summary: First Seacoast Bancorp filed an 8-K on September 24, 2026, disclosing receipt of the last regulatory approvals and waivers needed to complete its merger into Cambridge Financial Group, Inc., with First Seacoast Bank merging into Cambridge Savings Bank. Stockholders approved the transactions at an August 27, 2026 special meeting. Closing is expected October 1, 2026, subject to customary conditions. No price, premium, or advisor was disclosed in this excerpt. The regulatory clock has cleared; watch for deal completion confirmation, any last-minute condition failures, and final merger consideration mechanics as the spread narrows to zero.
